title: Critical Security: External API Dependency in Assessment Generator
body: The `.github/workflows/Jules-Assessment-Generator.yml` workflow depends on `jules.googleapis.com` and transmits repository data to this external endpoint. This creates a critical supply chain risk and data privacy concern. Remove the dependency or ensure it is authorized and authenticated securely.

title: High Risk: Dangerous Permissions in Archivist Workflow
body: The `.github/workflows/Jules-Archivist.yml` workflow requires `contents: write` permissions to delete remote branches (`git push origin --delete`). This is a high-risk configuration. Restrict this workflow or require manual approval.

title: CI/CD: Fix Pipeline Instability and Syntax Errors
body: Multiple workflows (e.g., `CI Standard`, `Jules-Control-Tower`) are failing due to syntax or indentation errors as seen in `workflow_runs_tools.txt`. Fix the configuration to ensure reliable builds.

title: Security: Insecure Global Package Installation
body: The `.github/workflows/Jules-Assessment-Remediator.yml` workflow uses `npm install -g` and `pip install ... || true`. Replace global installs with `npm ci` / virtual environments and remove failure masking.
